calibration.method: empirical split-conformal-style calibration on tune rows
calibration.caveat: no coverage guarantee: calibration shares the tune split with v1 hyperparameter selection; all coverage numbers are empirical measurements on named splits, not guaranteed rates

post_hoc_notice: post-hoc evaluation on replay/test: method chosen after v1 results on this split were known; not an untouched confirmation

tune_calibration_global.label: in-sample on the calibration rows; optimistic by construction

tune_crossfitted_global.design: leave-one-unit-out within the tune split; empirical, same development sample that selected v1 hyperparameters

tune_calibration_stratified.label: in-sample on the calibration rows; optimistic by construction

tune_crossfitted_stratified.design: leave-one-unit-out within the tune split; empirical, same development sample that selected v1 hyperparameters

selection_rule: stratified only if cross-fitted coverage >= global + 2pts and width <= global * 1.10; fixed before measurement

replay_band_v2.label: post-hoc evaluation on replay-holdout: method chosen after v1 results on this split were known; not an untouched confirmation

test_endpoint_band_v2.label: post-hoc evaluation on official test endpoints: method chosen after v1 results on this split were known; not an untouched confirmation

warning_policy_selection.registry: P0 v1_q50, P1 q90 (raw, uncalibrated), P2 calibrated_lower, P3 persistence_3; registry timeline in evaluate_v2.py docstring; P1 omitted from the note sent to parent - disclosed expansion; P3 added in run 2 after run-1 replay numbers were seen

v1_q50.policy: exclusive first-alert episode policy (declared, not universal); per-cycle FPR and latched burden are different quantities
